name: FoaPanB
description: First-order Ambisonic B-format encoder (sc3-plugins ATK). Places a mono source on the unit sphere, producing the four-channel B-format soundfield (W, X, Y, Z) for the given azimuth/elevation. NOTE: this manifest covers only the C++ server UGens from ATK. Higher-level helper classes from the atk-sc3 quark (FoaEncoderMatrix, FoaXformerMatrix, FoaDecoderKernel, HoaEncodeDirection, HoaRotate, …) are sclang-only and must be ported manually if needed.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Mono input signal to encode into B-format

inputs.name: azimuth
inputs.description: Azimuth angle in radians (0 = front, pi/2 = left, -pi/2 = right, ±pi = back)

inputs.name: elevation
inputs.description: Elevation angle in radians (-pi/2 = below, 0 = horizontal, pi/2 = above)

name: FoaDirectO
description: FOA omni-directivity (origin) transform — adjusts the directivity of the B-format soundfield around its centre, collapsing the field towards omni at -pi/2 and expanding it back at 0. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Directivity angle in radians (0 = unchanged, ±pi/2 = full omni / collapsed soundfield)

name: FoaDirectX
description: FOA directivity transform along the X axis — adjusts the directivity of the soundfield around the front-back (X) axis. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Directivity angle in radians, applied around the X axis

name: FoaDirectY
description: FOA directivity transform along the Y axis — adjusts the directivity of the soundfield around the left-right (Y) axis. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Directivity angle in radians, applied around the Y axis

name: FoaDirectZ
description: FOA directivity transform along the Z axis — adjusts the directivity of the soundfield around the up-down (Z) axis. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Directivity angle in radians, applied around the Z axis

name: FoaRotate
description: Rotate a B-format soundfield about the Z (vertical) axis — equivalent to spinning the soundfield left/right around the listener. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Rotation angle in radians (positive = counter-clockwise viewed from above)

name: FoaTilt
description: Rotate a B-format soundfield about the X (front-back) axis — tilts the soundfield left-right. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Tilt angle in radians around the X axis

name: FoaTumble
description: Rotate a B-format soundfield about the Y (left-right) axis — tumbles the soundfield front-back over the listener's head. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Tumble angle in radians around the Y axis

name: FoaFocusX
description: FOA focus transform along the X (front-back) axis — pulls the soundfield towards a directional point at ±X. Lossless equivalent of zoom; the focus angle pi/2 collapses the field to that direction. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Focus angle in radians (0 = unchanged, ±pi/2 = fully focused along the X axis)

name: FoaFocusY
description: FOA focus transform along the Y (left-right) axis — pulls the soundfield towards a directional point at ±Y. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Focus angle in radians around the Y axis

name: FoaFocusZ
description: FOA focus transform along the Z (up-down) axis — pulls the soundfield towards a directional point at ±Z. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Focus angle in radians around the Z axis

name: FoaPushX
description: FOA push transform along the X axis — pushes the soundfield towards a directional point at ±X. Distorts amplitude relationships (unlike Focus, which preserves energy). From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Push angle in radians (0 = unchanged, ±pi/2 = fully pushed along the X axis)

name: FoaPushY
description: FOA push transform along the Y axis — pushes the soundfield towards a directional point at ±Y. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Push angle in radians around the Y axis

name: FoaPushZ
description: FOA push transform along the Z axis — pushes the soundfield towards a directional point at ±Z. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Push angle in radians around the Z axis

name: FoaPressX
description: FOA press transform along the X axis — flattens the soundfield onto the X-axis plane, similar to Push but with different amplitude weighting. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Press angle in radians (0 = unchanged, ±pi/2 = fully pressed onto the X axis)

name: FoaPressY
description: FOA press transform along the Y axis — flattens the soundfield onto the Y-axis plane. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Press angle in radians around the Y axis

name: FoaPressZ
description: FOA press transform along the Z axis — flattens the soundfield onto the Z-axis plane. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Press angle in radians around the Z axis

name: FoaZoomX
description: FOA zoom transform along the X axis — emphasises one direction along the X axis at the expense of the opposite, with an overall gain change. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Zoom angle in radians (0 = unchanged, ±pi/2 = fully zoomed along the X axis)

name: FoaZoomY
description: FOA zoom transform along the Y axis. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Zoom angle in radians around the Y axis

name: FoaZoomZ
description: FOA zoom transform along the Z axis. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Zoom angle in radians around the Z axis

name: FoaDominateX
description: FOA dominance transform along the X axis — applies a 'dominance' (Lorentz-style boost) to the soundfield, increasing the apparent gain in one X direction while attenuating the opposite. Measured in dB. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: gain
inputs.description: Dominance gain in dB applied along the X axis (0 = unchanged)

name: FoaDominateY
description: FOA dominance transform along the Y axis. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: gain
inputs.description: Dominance gain in dB applied along the Y axis

name: FoaDominateZ
description: FOA dominance transform along the Z axis. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: gain
inputs.description: Dominance gain in dB applied along the Z axis

name: FoaAsymmetry
description: FOA asymmetry transform — distorts the soundfield laterally (around the median plane), shifting energy from front/back to one side. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: angle
inputs.description: Asymmetry angle in radians (0 = symmetric, ±pi/2 = full asymmetric distortion)

name: FoaNFC
description: Near-Field Compensation filter for B-format. Compensates for the proximity-effect colouration introduced by an Ambisonic encoding at finite distance, by applying a high-pass filter to X/Y/Z channels with a cutoff derived from the assumed source distance. W is passed through unchanged. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: distance
inputs.description: Encoding/reference distance in metres — sets the high-pass cutoff (smaller = higher cutoff)

inputs.name: speedOfSound
inputs.description: Speed of sound in metres/second — used together with distance to derive the cutoff frequency. Optional; older atk-sc3 quarks (<=v5.0.3) instantiate without this input and the UGen falls back to 333 m/s

name: FoaProximity
description: Proximity-effect filter for B-format — the dual of FoaNFC. Adds the distance-dependent low-frequency boost a real listener would experience near a sound source, by applying a one-pole low-shelf (1+integrator) to X/Y/Z. W passes through unchanged. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: distance
inputs.description: Source distance in metres — smaller distances produce a stronger proximity boost

inputs.name: speedOfSound
inputs.description: Speed of sound in metres/second. Optional; older atk-sc3 quarks (<=v5.0.3) instantiate without this input and the UGen falls back to 333 m/s

name: FoaPsychoShelf
description: Psychoacoustic shelf filter for B-format — applies frequency-dependent gains separately to the W (pressure) and X/Y/Z (velocity) channels around a crossover frequency. Used to compensate for the perceptual difference between low- and high-frequency localisation cues during decoding. From sc3-plugins ATK.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Shelf crossover frequency in Hz (typically ~400 Hz for psychoacoustic decoding)

inputs.name: k0
inputs.description: Low-frequency shelf gain factor applied below the crossover (linear, 1.0 = unity)

inputs.name: k1
inputs.description: High-frequency shelf gain factor applied above the crossover (linear, 1.0 = unity)
